machine.kind: single Vorflux cloud sandbox VM; every engine ran on it, serially

gbrain_evals.dirty_note: the runs used this branch's uncommitted harness patch (the same code this PR commits)

gbrain_under_test.loaded_code: garrytan/gbrain 6ad51d6b90dd1ad7d827e8061b8dce588865ccf3 (branch rust-cli-members, 0.60.737.0, committed 2026-11-18T16:09:39Z), symlinked as node_modules/gbrain

engines.pglite: in-process, in-memory PGLite (WASM) from the same gbrain build

postgres.transport: TCP over the loopback interface into a Docker container on the same VM
postgres.database: fresh scratch database per run, dropped on close

locale.note: not recorded for the 6ad51d6b or dbc85b2d runs; the container started without locale flags

engines.rust: gbrain Rust store engine (napi-rs addon above), fresh temp store per run

bench.corpus: eval/data/world-v1 (full index; 30 concept pages carry the gold)
bench.embedding_cache: one shared SQLite cache (--embed-cache). The warm-up run paid for every vector (1028 misses); all six scored runs had 1028 hits and 0 misses, so every engine searched byte-identical vectors
bench.isolation: GBRAIN_HOME set to an empty scratch dir per run (the sandbox ~/.gbrain config has embedding_disabled=true, which otherwise turns hybrid search keyword-only)
bench.order: rust r1-r3, then pglite r1, postgres r1, pglite r2, postgres r2, pglite r3, postgres r3; serial, nothing else running

gbrain_under_test.loaded_code: garrytan/gbrain dbc85b2d19111666a4f26b8f1052d86741a622e4 (branch rust-engine/lane6-import-embedding-column, 0.60.737.0, committed 2026-11-18T19:56:02Z), symlinked as node_modules/gbrain

second_build.machine: same VM as the first build (restarted between builds); Postgres container recreated from the same image digest and settings
second_build.embedding_cache: same SQLite cache; every run 1576 hits, 0 misses, 0 paid requests
second_build.order: rust r1, pglite ctl, rust r2, postgres ctl, rust r3; serial, nothing else running

postgres_locale.query: SELECT datname, datcollate, datctype, datlocprovider, pg_encoding_to_char(encoding) FROM pg_database

warm_passes.cold: first query pass after import; the only scored pass
warm_passes.warm: same probes repeated on the same brain; timed, not scored
warm_passes.report: cold p50/p95 and warm p50/p95 separately

method.gbev3: any published warm p95 shows the count and reasons of excluded degraded repeats beside it
method.rust: Rust numbers stay out of results tables on main until a named gbrain release can select the Rust engine (expected via engine: "rust" in config and gbrain init, from 2026-11-21); branch-build Rust runs are diagnostics only
